title: AMSYS Recognized as NVIDIA State and Local Government Partner of the Year
excerpt: HOUSTON, TX, March 19, 2026 — AMSYS, a leading provider of AI-powered technology solutions and intelligent infrastructure, proudly announced today that it has been recognized as the NVIDIA State and Local Government Partner of the Year as part of the 2026 NVIDIA Partner Network (NPN) Awards.
